title: Shared idle timeout parsing and release
summary: Checks that invalid idle-timeout settings are rejected in isolated QA processes and that both providers release inactive runners at the configured time. It also checks that a new turn resets the timer, zero disables idle release and an omitted setting defaults to one hour.
prerequisites: Use dedicated QA relay and runner modules/CLI versions that support idle release on both providers; confirm timing begins at completed turn, not claim or workspace start.
Parser-negative variants run only in an isolated QA process with no production pools; do not destabilize serving relay.
For runtime variants record provider turn-completion UTC time and attachment/workspace status; distinguish idle release from autostop and manual termination.

variants.title: Old Claude key rejected
variants.summary: In an isolated QA process, checks that the obsolete Claude idle setting prevents startup and points to the replacement setting. No serving process should become ready.

steps.action: In isolated QA process add obsolete release_idle_session_min to QA Claude pool config and attempt startup.
steps.expected: Startup fails naming release_idle_session_min and idle_release_timeout; no serving process becomes ready.
steps.evidence: Sanitized process exit code/error and config key names only.

cleanup: Remove obsolete key and terminate isolated process.

variants.title: Unitless positive Cursor timeout rejected
variants.summary: In an isolated QA process, checks that a positive Cursor idle timeout without a time unit is rejected at startup. No serving process should become ready.

steps.action: In isolated QA process set Cursor idle_release_timeout to JSON number 10 (not 10m) and attempt startup.
steps.expected: Startup config parsing rejects unitless positive value; no serving process becomes ready.
steps.evidence: Sanitized exit code/error and nonsecret input value.

cleanup: Restore duration string in private isolated config.

variants.title: 10m idle release both providers
variants.summary: Checks that both provider runners stay available before ten minutes of inactivity and that a follow-up turn restarts the countdown. If they remain healthy, each should release by twelve minutes after its last turn, not because of an unrelated shutdown.

steps.action: Apply 10m timeout to both QA pools, restart QA relay and finish one turn each; record each last-turn completion UTC and check runner remains connected at T+9m. Send a follow-up before release and record new last-turn time.
steps.expected: Runner still available at T+9m and follow-up succeeds; countdown resets from follow-up completion.
steps.evidence: Per-provider turn and follow-up timestamps, runner metadata/status.

steps.action: After each last turn, sample at T+10m, +11m, +12m (poll every 30s) for idle release, not from original turn if follow-up reset it.
steps.expected: Each runner releases by T+12m without manual shutdown; no release before T+10m and no misattributed autostop. If provider removes session earlier, mark blocked, not pass.
steps.evidence: Timestamped runner status/metadata and provider release outcome.

cleanup: Close QA sessions and verify normal reap or record authorized targeted cleanup.

variants.title: Zero disables idle release
variants.summary: Checks that setting idle release to zero keeps otherwise healthy Claude and Cursor runners from being released for inactivity through twelve minutes after a turn. Unrelated workspace shutdowns must not count as an idle release.

steps.action: Apply idle_release_timeout 0 to both QA pools and restart; complete one turn each, then observe runner every 30s until T+12m.
steps.expected: No idle-release transition through T+12m while workspace is otherwise healthy; account for independent autostop and provider termination.
steps.evidence: Config hash, turn timestamp and per-provider runner status timeline.

cleanup: End sessions, restore baseline 10m, restart QA relay and verify authorized cleanup.

variants.title: Omitted key defaults to 1h, optional long slot
variants.summary: When the longer observation slot is available and both sessions stay healthy, checks that leaving out the setting keeps each runner active at 55 minutes but releases it by 65 minutes. Earlier provider or workspace shutdown must not count as proof of the default.

steps.action: Remove idle_release_timeout keys from both QA pools, restart, complete one turn each and inspect at T+55m and T+65m with 30s polls near boundary.
steps.expected: No idle release at T+55m; idle release by T+65m if session/workspace stayed healthy and attached state did not independently terminate it.
steps.evidence: Per-provider last-turn UTC, runner status at both checkpoints and config hash.

cleanup: Restore baseline 10m, restart QA relay and close/clean only owned sessions.

notes: Run one timing variant at a time; wait_seconds denotes elapsed observation with actual timestamped polls, not blind sleep.
Whole-minute Claude durations and whole-second Cursor durations apply; 0 is a disable value, not unitless positive.
